copy.tagline: 保持角色和画风在系列作品中始终一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多张AI生成图像中维持角色形象统一
copy.tagline_en: Keep characters and art style consistent across series
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need consistent character appearance across multiple AI-generated images

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会作为艺术总监和视觉QA专家，检查并确保生成图像和视频中角色和艺术风格的一致性，防止风格漂移和细节变化。
howto.when: 当你提到“角色一致性”、“艺术风格”、“同一角色”等关键词，或要求检查视觉连贯性、角色身份时触发。

say.text: 检查这两张图的角色面部是否一致。
say.note: Claude 会根据参考文件分析并指出差异。

say.text: 帮我保持这个角色的服装细节在系列中不变。
say.note: Claude 会提醒使用参考图并验证一致性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an art director and visual QA specialist, checking and ensuring character and art style consistency in generated images and videos, preventing style drift and detail changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'character consistency', 'art style', 'same character', or request visual continuity or character identity checks.

say_en.text: Check if the faces of these two images are consistent.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and point out differences using reference files.

say_en.text: Keep this character's outfit details consistent across the series.
say_en.note: Claude will remind to use reference images and verify consistency.
